intro.text: Someone a letter-writer reports dead along with Aona, with what the two of them held now Splintered.
Someone who, with Aona, is dead, what they held now Splintered; a letter-writer calls the pair foolish for violating a pact from the very beginning.
One of the Shards. He and Aona settled in the same place, against the Shards' agreement, and both are dead, their power Splintered.

items.text: Odium set Skai against Aona, then killed him while the struggle had left him weak.
